PreceptDef.label: Remembrance of the Departed
PreceptDef.description: Worshippers gather before a grave or memorial to remember the departed in silence beneath the gaze of the old gods. If the body is lost, an empty grave may be used.
PreceptDef.extraTextPawnDeathLetter: {PAWN_nameDef} should be buried and given a Remembrance of the Departed so the community may keep {PAWN_possessive} memory before the old gods.

PreceptDef.label: beautiful
PreceptDef.description: Snow blankets the world in austere beauty and reminds everyone that winter must be respected.

PreceptDef.label: dishonorable
PreceptDef.description: Secret manipulation, bribery, sabotage, poisoning, and abduction stain the honor of those who order them.
